build_masked_sbu_dataset: build a masked SBU captions dataset using the MaskedSBUBuilder registered in the MMF framework
create_masked_sbu_builder: create a MaskedSBUBuilder instance that sets the dataset name to masked_sbu and configures MaskedSBUDataset
review_config_path: review the MaskedSBUBuilder config_path method to confirm it returns the masked.yaml config path
test_masked_sbu_registration: test that MaskedSBUBuilder is correctly registered under the masked_sbu key in the MMF registry
refactor_masked_sbu_builder: refactor the MaskedSBUBuilder to customize dataset initialization or override inherited MaskedCOCOBuilder methods
